RAJYA   SABHA
—————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 8, 2004/Agrahayana 17, 1926 (Saka)
—————
(Ministries: Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional Energy Sources;
Power; Rural Development; Textiles; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions—20
31
Steps to increase employment
opportunities in rural areas
*101. SHRI SANJAY RAUT:  Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) the estimated number of unemployed
persons in rural areas of the country
particularly in Maharashtra;
(b) whether any evaluation of the
Central Government's programmes to
increase employment opportunities in the
rural areas in the country has been made by
the Union Government; and
(c) if so, the outcome thereof?
Selection criteria for Arjuna Awards
†*102. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS  be pleased to state:
(a) the criteria of selection for Arjuna
Awards;
(b) the reaction of Ministry regarding
doubts expressed by renowned
sportspersons  every year over the
transparency adopted for the selection of
awards;
(c) whether  Government  are taking
any step to avoid such controversies; and
(d) whether it is a fact that despite
showing good performance, some   deserving
sportspersons are  deprived of Awards?
Militant efforts to sneak into J&K
*103. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister  of DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that militants in
Pakistan Occupied Kashmir have recently
stepped up their efforts to sneak into
Jammu and Kashmir valley; and
(b) if so, how many infiltrators have
actually been killed by the Armed Forces
and how many of them have sneaked in
Jammu and Kashmir during the last two
months?
Bifurcation of Northern and Southern
regions of PGCIL
*104. SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR: Will the Minister of
POWER  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Northern region and
Southern region of Power Grid Corporation
of India Ltd. (PGCIL) were bifurcated in
two sub-regions;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
the reasons for bifurcation;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

32
(c) whether there is a similar plan to
bifurcate other regions also; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Pension to Freedom Fighters
*105. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a scheme for
payment of pension to Freedom  Fighters
had been introduced at the inception of our
Republic;
(b) the salient details of the scheme so
introduced especially eligibility criteria, rate
of pension per individual/dependents, mode
of payment etc., and revision, if any, made
therein till date;
(c) whether the Freedom Fighters
belonging to Azad Hind Fauz (INA) were
equally eligible to the pension scheme at
its very inception or at subsequent stage;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the reasons for their exclusion from
the Freedom Fighters' Pension facility at
the inception of the scheme?
R&D projects on hydrogen energy
*106. SHRI R.P. GOENKA:  Will the
Minister of NON-CONVENTIONAL
ENERGY SOURCES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a plan has
been formulated to support some R&D
projects, recommended by the National
Hydrogen Energy Board, on different
aspects of hydrogen energy, including
production, storage and utilization of
hydrogen as a fuel; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the time-frame fixed and financial
allocations made, project-wise?
Assistance to Orissa for relief system
in natural calamities
*107. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
Orissa proposes to develop permanent
relief system during natural calamities to
control casualities and other damages;
(b) if so, the details of the project;
(c) whether Centre propose to render
support both financial and physical to the
State for execution of the above project;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Grant under Accelerated Power
Development and Improvement
Programme
†*108. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of POWER  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether under the Accelerated Power
Development and Improvement
Programme, the Ministry provides 50 per
cent of the project cost for improvement
of sub-transmission and distribution
networks of which 50 per cent is provided
in the form of grant and 50 per cent of loan;
(b) whether, in view of various steps
taken by the Government of Rajasthan for
reforms in the Power sector, the Central
Government have any plan to provide the
90 per cent  of the allocation amount in the
form of grant and 10 per cent in the form of
loan under this scheme; and
(c) if so, the details thereof, if not, the
reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

33
Dual citizenship to NRIs
†*109. SHRIMATI   SAVITA
SHARDA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
provide dual citizenship to Non-Resident
Indians residing abroad;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when final decision is likely to be
taken in this regard?
Participation of STs in Army, Navy
and Air Force
*110. SHRI URKHAO GWRA
BRAHMA:  Will the Minister of
DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether  it is a fact that the
participation rate of Scheduled Tribes  in
Army, Navy and Air Force is poor;
(b) whether separate data of number of
STs in Defence forces is maintained; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Naxalites rise and menace in
Karnataka
*111. DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware
about rise in Naxalite activities in Karnataka
in Chikmagalur and Mangalore districts,
spread over Western Ghats area;
(b) if so, what are the steps taken to
prevent naxalite activities;
(c) whether the living of Tribal people
in those  areas is being disturbed and
dislocated; and
(d) what are the steps taken by the State
Government to rehabilitate these Tribals?
Implementation of PMGSY
*112. SHRI ABDUL WAHAB
PEEVEE: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) the States where Pradhan Mantri
Gram Sadak Yojana has not been
implemented/extended so  far; and
(b) the status of schemes under PMGSY
in Kerala?
Impact of infiltration from
Bangladesh
†*113. SHRI RUDRA
NARAYAN PANY: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a) what action is being taken by
Government to tackle the social and political
problems in the North Eastern States and
West Bengal due to the infiltration of
millions of Bangladeshis;
(b) whether the illegal intrusion from
Bangladesh is the reason behind the recent
terrorist violence in the North Eastern
States;
(c) whether  Centre has prepared any
integrated scheme with the help of these
States in this regard;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Power generation  through Wind and
Solar Energy
†*114.   SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of NON-
CONVENTIONAL ENERGY SOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) the details in megawatts of power
generated in the country through Solar and
Wind Energy during the  last three years;
and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

34
(b) the places where Solar and Wind
Energy are being used alongwith number of
people who are making use of said energy?
Proposal for a National programme to
exploit solar energy
†*115. SHRI R.S. GAVAI:  Will the
Minister  of NON-CONVENTIONAL
ENERGY SOURCES be pleased to state
whether Government propose to make a
nation wide programme to exploit solar
energy so that the villages in remote areas
could be benefited?
Migration of rural labour
*116. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are planning to launch a new scheme for
discouraging  migration of rural labour;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have identified
the pockets of such migration in the
country; and
(d) whether Government propose to
consult the States before launching such
scheme?
National Rural Employment
Guarantee Bill
*117. SHRI MURLI DEORA:
SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
introduce National Rural Employment
Guarantee Bill during the Winter
Session;
(b) if so, the salient features of the draft
Bill;
(c) the amount required for the
implementation of this scheme; and
(d) whether States would also share the
burden of  this scheme and if so, the
percentage  thereof and whether the scheme
would be applicable in those States too
who are incapable of contributing?
Kidnapping of children for organ theft
*118. SHRI ANAND SHARMA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to  media reports on the
kidnapping of children by organized gangs
for organ theft;
(b) if so, the States where such gangs
are active; and
(c) what action has been taken to protect
the children by the Centre and the concerned
States?
Loss of textile exports
*119. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of TEXTILES  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India which
was in the forefront in textile exports has
largely lost its textile exports in the world
market; and
(b) whether Government have gone
into the causes for such loss of textile
exports and evolve a new policy and
strategy to regain its lost position in
the world market; and if so, the details
thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

35
Setting up of Commissions to look
into Centre-State relations
*120. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government  propose to
set up two Commissions to look into
Centre-State relations including issues like
sharing of  river water and to examine
administrative reforms  which were
reviewed four decades ago;
(b) what are the main reasons for the
same and to what extent it will be different
than the earlier one;
(c) by  when final decision in regard to
setting up of two Commissions is likely to
be taken; and
(d) by what time, the Commissions are
likely to submit their reports?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 2nd December, 2004 Secretary-General.

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 8, 2004/Agrahayana 17, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power;
Rural Development; Textiles; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 122
Medical examination of female
candidates to the army
571. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is no provision of a
lady doctor to conduct medical
examination of a female candidate for
recruitment in the army;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the justification of getting a female
candidate medically examined by a male
doctor;
(d) whether, keeping in view the
growing number of women in the army,
Government propose to ask the authorities
to appoint lady doctors for the purpose; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Supply of PC-3 Orion Naval Surveil-
lance Planes to Pakistan by U.S.
572. SHRI ANAND SHARMA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government’s attention has
been drawn to recent news reports on US
decision to supply PC-3 Orion Naval
Surveillance Planes to Pakistan; and
(b) if so, the veracity of the same and
the likely impact on the balance of Naval
forces in the region?
Reduction of army in Siachen by India
and Pakistan
573. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether an agreement has lately
been reached between Indian and Pakistani
authorities to reduce the army in Siachen;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps since taken in this regard?
Violation of ceasefire by Pakistan
574. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it has come to the notice of
Government that Pakistan is taking full
advantage of the ceasefire along the LoC
(Line of Control) and IB (International
Border) and is building new bunkers and
raising the height of old ones at as many as
200 places along the LoC to make it easy
for Pakistan to target Indian positions and

127
civilian areas if the ceasefire fails to
hold;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reaction of Government thereto?
Starting production of aerotyres in
Dunlop units
575. SHRI  DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to refer to reply to Unstarred
Question 1082 given in the Rajya Sabha
on 13th March, 2002 regarding production
of aerotyres in Dunlop units and state:
(a) whether any action has been taken
by Government to start production of
aerotyres for Air Force from Dunlop;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor;
(c) by when any Group of Ministers are
being formed in line with revival of Dabhol
plant of Enron project to bail out Dunlop
units; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Non-utilisation of funds for purchase
of arms
576. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the funds
allocated for the purchase of arms and
ammunitions for the Defence Forces
largely remain unutilized in recent years;
(b) if so, the quantum of such funds;
(c) the reasons for non-utilisation of
funds; and
(d) whether the non-utilisation of funds
has affected the preparedness of the Armed
Forces in any way?
Attachment policy of armed forces
officers to IDSA
577. DR. NARAYAN SINGH
MANAKLAO: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Deputation/Study
Leave/Attachment policy of the armed
forces officers in Institute for Defence
Studies and Analyses (IDSA);
(b) the number of serving armed forces
officer(s) holding important administrative
post(s) of the Institute alongwith their
attachment period and reason for retention,
individual-wise, as per rules;
(c) whether Government propose to
review the policy for attachment of armed
forces officers to IDSA and for repatriation
of long serving officers to their parent
armed forces in the national interest; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Denial of benefits to unit-run canteen
employees
578. SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Supreme
Court declared the unit-run canteen
employees as Central Government
employees; and
(b) if so, the reasons for depriving them
of benefits like, DA, HRA, Bonus and
Gratuity etc.?
Rules for posting of army officers in
MES on tenure basis
579. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there exist
no comprehensive rules for posting of army
officers in MES on tenure basis; if so, the
reasons therefor;

128
(b) whether it is also a fact that two
civilian officers in MES in the scale of
Rs. 22,400-24,500 are designated as
Additional D.G. while an army officer in
the scale of Rs. 18,400-22,400 has been
designated as Director General; if so, the
reasons for such discrepancy; and
(c) to what extent the recommendations
of Vth Central Pay Commission have been
followed so far as the seniority as per pay
scale is concerned?
Steps for  safe-keeping of ammunition
580. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether according to the 21st Report
of the Standing Committee on Defence,
ammunition worth hundreds of crores of
rupees belonging to the Ministry of
Defence has been kept for years in a highly
unsafe manner, posing a grave risk to
human life and causing a huge loss to the
exchequer;
(b) whether it is a fact that out of 4.5
metric tonnes of ammunition about 0.93
lakh metric tonnes is still kept in the open,
covered only by tarpaulin or kept under a
tent; and
(c) the action Government propose to
take for safe conservation of ammunition?
Pakistan’s efforts to push terrorists
into J&K
581. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Pakistan had
stepped up its efforts to push terrorists into
Jammu and Kashmir;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the army
has foiled four major infiltration attempts
from across the Line of Control in the first
six days of November in which 11
militants, mostly Pakistani nationals have
been killed; and
(c) if so, in the light of these, whether
the decision to reduce ground armed forces
in Jammu and Kashmir is justified?
Shortage of higher ranking officers in
the army
†582. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that recently there
has been a shortage of higher ranking
officers in the Indian army and youths are
not interested to join the army;
(b) if so, whether Government are
considering any measures for raising the
present facilities like pay and allowances
etc. to motivate the youths; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Non-recovery of killer landmines
583. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that some killer landmines planted
by the Indian army in the Kassowal
Enclave, along the Indo-Pak border, two
years ago are nowhere to be traced;
(b) whether it is a fact that army sappers
have met no success in recovering the
M-16 'jumping jack' mines from some
minefields, despite countless rounds of
manual and mechanical demining; and
(c) if so, the action Government propose
to take in this matter?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

129
National War Memorial
†584. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
SHRI M.A.M. RAMA-
SWAMY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to refer to the replies to parts (b)
and (c) of Unstarred Question 1050 given
in the Rajya Sabha on 30th July, 2003 and
state:
(a) whether Government are
considering to build a National War
Memorial; if so, the scheme formulated in
this regard;
(b) the dates on which the Ministry of
Defence had sent communications to the
Ministry of Urban Development for
allotting a plot acceptable to defence
authorities;
(c) the response of the Ministry of
Urban Development; and
(d) the present status in this regard?
Soldiers killed during shooting practice
†585. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of soldiers killed during
the shooting practice in the country
particularly in Bareilly from 1st January,
2000 to 31st October, 2004;
(b) what were the causes for their
deaths;
(c) whether any compensation was paid
to the families of the deceased; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Replacement of ageing Air Force and
Naval fleet
586. SHRIMATI  N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Navy and Air Force need
to add to their dwindling fleets;
(b) if so, their demands; and
(c) the action taken to add ships and
jets to replace ageing fleets?
Test fire of  Dhanush
587. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that ‘Dhanush’,
the indigenously developed short range
ballistic missile, was test fired from the Bay
of Bengal off the Orissa coast recently;
(b) whether it is a fact that ‘Dhanush’
is the naval version of the surface to surface
missile system Prithvi-II; and
(c) if so, when 'Dhanush' is expected to
become operational?
Financial clearance of specialised
clothing for soldiers at Siachen and
Kargil
588. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the army has
asked for three sets of specialised clothing
for soldiers at 16,000 feet at Siachen and
Kargil but have not yet got financial
clearance for the third set;
(b) whether it is a fact that the third set
is required for soldiers who may have to
be rushed in, in case hostilities break out
and to start the acclimatisation process for
the next batch, once the soldiers currently
at the Northern Command make their way
to Siachen and Kargil;
(c) whether it is a fact that total amount
required for three sets of winter clothing a
year is Rs. 142.2 crores out of the Defence
budget of Rs. 72,000 crore; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

130
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(d) if so, the reasons for delay in
according the financial clearance?
Shortage of special clothing and
equipment for troops at high attitudes
589. SHRI ANAND SHARMA:
SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government’s attention has
been drawn to the reported shortage of
special clothing and equipment for troops
deployed in high attitude regions;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken by the Army
Headquarters to ensure adequate and timely
availability of the same?
Upgradation of IAF
590. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that IAF Chief
has suggested downsizing and
simultaneously upgrading IAF to make it
more effective;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reaction of Government thereto?
MBT Arjun
591. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Army has
directed Armoured Corps to compare Arjun
with Russian-made T-90;
(b) if so, whether the tests are over; and
(c) the number of Arjun MBTs inducted
so far into the Indian Army?
Increase in infiltration in Jammu and
Kashmir
592. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the situation
in Jammu and Kashmir is improving;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the infiltration in the valley
has increased since January, 2004; and
(d) if so, the reasons for improvement
of the situation in the valley?
Atrocities on women
593. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the cases of
atrocities on women are on the increase in
the country;
(b) if so, the State-wise details of cases
reported during the last three years; and
(c) the details of action taken to prevent
such incidents?
Implementation of Foreign
Citizens Act
†594. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Foreign
citizens Act, 1946 is applicable on a few
States only;
(b) whether Government propose to
implement this law in all States including
Assam in order to check infiltration of
foreign national s;

131
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Meeting of CMS of Naxal affected
States
595. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether he held a meeting of Chief
Ministers of naxal-affected States, like
Madhya Pradesh, Jharkhand, Andhra
Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Bihar, Orissa,
Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh in
September, 2004;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the decisions taken at the meeting
for development in Naxal-affected districts,
particularly the tribal areas, in these States;
(d) whether there is need for a long term
strategy to tackle the Naxal problem instead
of merely treating it as a law and order
situation; and
(e) if so, the assistance the Central
Government have promised to provide to
each of these Naxal-affected States in this
regard?
Advance payment of security related
expenditure to States
596. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
used to re-imburse the amount spent by
State Governments on Security after the
expenses had been incurred, as a result of
which the police functioning in many States
had been hampered on account of paucity
of funds;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Union Government have
now taken a decision to provide Security
Related Expenditure to States in advance
to help them to further strengthen and
modernize the police force; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Naxalites violence in Uttar Pradesh
†597. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that recently some armed naxalites
had blasted a P.A.C. truck at Chandoli in
Uttar Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details regarding number of
soldiers killed alongwith the number of
injured in the said incident;
(d) whether Government have
formulated any plan for taking concrete
action to keep a check on recurrence of
such incidents; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Discontinuation of sale of Census
Commissioner's report
598. SHRIMATI  JAYA BACHCHAN:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the sale of
the Census Commissioner's report was
discontinued in early September, 2004; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
Separate Ministry for Disaster
Management
599. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether  Government have received

132
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
any report on Disaster Management, which
recommends a separate Ministry for
Disaster Management; and
(b) if so, Government's response thereto
and the steps Government have so far taken
or propose to take in this regard?
Findings of Justice Nanavati
Commission
